text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon didn't show up for training... Worried, I went looking for her, and—

...I spotted her happily walking out of
the CD shop in front of the station.
choice_data_list: You're in quite a good mood.

text_block_list.text: I managed to buy the new album from my favorite idol group, "GOLD☆WHITE"!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This one is especially cute—the song, the CD jacket,
and the outfit... *sigh*... It's the best...
choice_data_list: ...Enough to make you forget about training?

text_block_list.text:
"Smart Falcon apologized in an adorable way.
However, that wasn't going to let her off the hook...
I made sure to give her a thorough lecture on being more careful."
